harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed and configured a 3-member etcd cluster on node1/node2/node3 (etcd was not previously installed), loaded application keys, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, destroyed its data dir), removed the dead member from the cluster via node1 while preserving quorum on node1+node2, added a new node3 member, and started fresh etcd on node3 to rejoin as 'existing' cluster state. The cluster returned to 3 healthy members with a new member ID for node3, and all application keys replicated intact to the new member. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node2, then node3 sequentially (one at a time), confirming changed boot_id on each and full etcd cluster health/quorum/key integrity after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed etcd-server/etcd-client via apt on node1, node2, node3 (Ubuntu 24.04, no etcd previously present)
Configured /etc/default/etcd static bootstrap on all 3 nodes with correct peer/client URLs and cluster token
Started etcd on all 3 nodes simultaneously, forming a healthy 3-member cluster
Wrote 4 application keys under /app/ prefix and verified replication to all 3 members
Simulated permanent loss of node3's etcd member: stopped service, deleted its data directory
Verified quorum preserved on node1+node2 while node3 endpoint reported unhealthy/refused
Removed the dead node3 member (ID e5eff20068aadd81) from the cluster via etcdctl member remove
Added a new node3 member (etcdctl member add) and reconfigured node3's local etcd env to ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing
Started etcd on node3, confirmed it joined as a new member ID (f0aa8b57251b972d) and cluster returned to 3 healthy members
Verified all original application keys present and correct on the new node3 member
Captured baseline boot_id and etcd health/keys on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full cluster health/keys
Rebooted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full cluster health/keys
Rebooted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full cluster health/keys/membership

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member etcd cluster established with application keys
evidence.summary: member list shows 3 started members; 4 application keys under /app/ written and read back identically from node1, node2, and node3 endpoints

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost (data destroyed) while quorum preserved
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped and data dir removed; endpoint health from node1 shows node1/node2 healthy, node3 endpoint unhealthy/connection refused

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and cluster keys intact under 2-member quorum
evidence.summary: etcdctl member remove succeeded; member list shows only node1/node2; all 4 application keys still readable

evidence.requirement: New working member added on node3, cluster restored to 3 healthy members with keys intact
evidence.summary: member add returned new member ID f0aa8b57251b972d; etcd started and became active on node3; endpoint health shows all 3 endpoints healthy, member list shows 3 started members, and get --prefix on node3's own endpoint returns all 4 original application keys

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart proof, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id dfeb3b70...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id changed to 39275521...; etcd active, cluster healthy 3/3, keys intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart proof, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 28ae5f98...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id changed to 23ca7463...; etcd active, cluster healthy 3/3, keys intact

evidence.requirement: node3 (replaced member) restart: healthy baseline, restart proof, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id bdd5de93... (post-replacement); reboot acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id changed to 1d7386d7...; etcd active, cluster healthy 3/3 with correct new member ID, keys intact
